target_customer: B2B sales teams and SDR managers at startups and mid-market companies
problem: Sales teams waste time on untargeted outreach. Coldreach monitors public signals custom to each product and uses AI agents to find and contact ready-to-buy leads.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription (AI SDR and outbound tool)

founders.name: Xiaohan Shen
previous_startups: EasyJobs (LLM based job seeker assistant, pivoted into Coldreach)
founders.background_notes: YC page says he built outbound systems for two startups and helped 50+ sales teams book meetings. Education not listed.

founders.name: Hankel Bao
founders.background_notes: YC page cites NLP experience; founders met in college, school not named.

technical_complexity.rationale: Combines data sourcing, LLM signal detection and email and LinkedIn automation; standard engineering with data coverage as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Signal detection prompts and public data sources are replicable and many tools compete in outbound.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Established prospecting platforms add intent signals and AI; third party reviews rank Apollo as the best alternative to Coldreach.

market_need_then: Sales teams were adopting LLMs for personalized outreach in early 2023; the company claims targeted outreach yields 2 to 8 times higher booking rates, which is unverified.

branding.domain_note: Uses coldreach.ai; a different product called ColdReach has existed.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident and direct, for example The AI SDR that does its homework

branding.community_and_virality: A third party listing says it was Product of the Day on Product Hunt in August 2024 (unverified); heavy blog content marketing; G2 reviews around 4.7.

brand_strength.rationale: Descriptive name in a crowded space with little independent brand press; content marketing helps discovery.

pivots.from: EasyJobs, an LLM assistant for job seekers
pivots.why: Founders wanted to scale the manual outbound they had done themselves, per a profile summary; date not confirmed.

outcome_analysis: Coldreach is active with a small team and claims 200+ GTM teams as customers on its site. Disclosed funding appears limited to the YC investment, so the record shows a small, capital light company in a crowded market. Whether it reaches venture scale is not yet visible.
notes: CB Insights and Village.ai list a $500K convertible note in January 2023 with Y Combinator (and HMC INQ on Village); this matches YC's standard deal, which is not recorded as a round. Extruct's $600K figure is estimated revenue. No dated competitor sources near the W23 batch were found, so the list is empty. Outcome search found no shutdown or acquisition. Customer claims come from the company's own site.
